history.summary: The Kupunli Cave Temple is a cave shrine near Hunli in the Lower Dibang Valley, about 90 km from Roing; a roughly two-hour trek from Hunli town leads to it, and it is described as a sacred pilgrimage site for local tribes (roing.nic.in, traveltriangle.com). TOWN CORRECTION: the CSV lists Roing, but all sources place the temple near Hunli - town set to Hunli. DEITY CONFLICT: one travel source calls it a Shiva cave temple (praveenmusafir.com), another says trekkers 'get blessings from the goddess' (pickyourtrail.com) - the presiding deity is unresolved. Its age and history are undocumented. Coordinates are approximate (Hunli town-level).

name: Kupunli Cave Temple
town_description: Hunli is a scenic small town in the Lower Dibang Valley at about 5,000 feet, on the Roing-Anini road and a sub-divisional headquarters. It is the gateway to the Mayudia Pass and the Kupunli cave temple, and its hills and forests draw trekkers and nature lovers.

travel.airport: Tezu Airport (~120+ km via Roing, limited flights); Dibrugarh (Assam)
travel.road: Roing-Hunli road via Mayudia Pass, ~90 km from Roing; then ~2-hour trek from Hunli to the cave
